title: SundayReview
description: Output of the Sunday Review writer (AGENTS.md Role 5). profit_pulse, vacr_trend, and micro_check are pre-computed by deterministic code and passed in as input — the model narrates only.

pattern_insight.description: Narration grounded strictly in profit_pulse/vacr_trend fields, e.g. 'Sales actions: 40% completion. Ops actions: 90%.' Any numeric claim not traceable to an input field fails validation.
